summary: Two captured source banks do not replay. Independent mathematics, grading, rendering, delivery and packaging checks passed. The package remains unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Apply stated elementary row operations to an augmented matrix and select the resulting matrix.
reasoning_steps: Identify the operation, row roles and scalar.
Update every affected entry, including the constants column.
Use updated intermediate rows for sequential operations.
invariants: Use nonzero scaling and distinct addition source/target rows.
Provide exactly one correct radio choice among five.
permitted_variations: Vary entries, eligible row roles, scalar signs and magnitudes.
Rename matrices without changing mathematical responses.
Preserve the source difficulty and operation count.

source_replay.details: Two of 13 source cases fail complete replay: q-10252 has no matching scaling bank; q-72747 lacks its source profile. No affected generated inventory record was demonstrated; this is not a verified absence of other inventory defects.

math.details: Exact arithmetic reconstructed from prompts verifies the unique correct choice and final solution matrix for all 337 generated records.

variety.details: Independent easy samples cover all three swap pairs, three scaling targets and 19 factors. All 240 samples and five batch records survive delivery filtering. Learner selection was examined conditionally using the captured inventory; actual policy and history were unavailable.

scope.details: Observed questions preserve the supported operations, radio response contract and difficulty-specific workloads.

grading.details: The native grader correctly accepts 44 selections and rejects 176 distractors, including controlled counterfactuals. Free-entry notation is inapplicable.

rendering.details: The actual UI rendered 25 records successfully. Representative screenshots show readable notation, answer controls and worked solutions.

packaging.details: Exact Python version 3.13.5 matches the manifest. Deterministic replay and relocation pass for all difficulties. Package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant operation changes alter the computed and graded result; renaming preserves it. Conditional position and magnitude probes found no demonstrated incidental shortcut. Both batch swaps use R1/R2, limiting claims about row-pair coverage.
